title: Elizondo on 60 Minutes: the government said they're real

tellings.quote: not telling you they're real yeah the government just admitted that they're real

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official, appearing in 2021 on 60 Minutes, a long-running American TV news programme. Michels says the point was not that Elizondo himself was telling people UFOs are real, but that the government had just admitted they are. If so, that would be official acceptance that these objects exist.
